'''Tandem Library Books''', formerly known as [[Sagebrush Corporation|Sagebrush Books]], is a children's book distributor for libraries, publishes and book wholesalers. The Tandem Library group has published numerous [[Star Wars]] young reader [[List of books|novels]], including some of the novels in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Quest|Jedi Quest]] series.
